name: mateclaw-plugin-you-search
description: Adds You.com as a web-search provider via the You.com Search API (X-API-Key auth). Joins the web_search provider chain alongside serper / tavily / searxng / duckduckgo. Requires a You.com API key. Not part of the default stack.
author: Mouse Parker

apiKey.description: You.com API key (X-API-Key header). Get one at https://you.com/platform/api-keys

baseUrl.description: You.com Search API base URL. Default https://ydc-index.io

country.description: Country code for geographical focus of results, e.g. us / de. Optional.

safesearch.description: Content moderation filter: strict / moderate / off. Default off.
